context: Fictional Japanese general hospital. The player patrols as a night worker; patrol is not military service.

terms.ward: Hospital ward, not administrative district or person
terms.handover: Hospital shift handover between workers, not sign-in authentication
terms.flash: A carried device whose flash repels and stuns monsters; separate from the continuous flashlight beam
terms.decoy: A sound-making object dropped at the player's feet to distract a pursuer
terms.fuse: Electrical component; collect three to start exit power
terms.Listener: Monster that detects noise but cannot see
terms.Light-Shy: Monster that recoils from flashlight illumination
terms.Crying Patient: Monster that hunts continuously once provoked; flash ends the hunt

ja.hospital: 青葉市 松原総合病院
